data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 午后归档的小小成就
data.description: 午后的市政厅办公室，约尔穿橄榄绿制服外套、白衬衫和同色直裙，坐在档案桌旁。她一手按平打开的文件夹，另一手把最后一张纸对齐放入，确认纸角整齐后微微扬起嘴角。桌边一摞已经整理好的文件夹与窗台绿植映着柔和日光，黑发与金色耳饰轮廓清晰。
data.action: 坐在桌边，一手压住文件夹，另一手将最后一张纸对齐放入。
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: At the City Hall archive desk, Yor holds an open folder flat and aligns its final sheet, relaxing into a small smile as the corners meet. Her olive uniform blazer, white shirt and matching straight skirt remain in the seated three-quarter medium view. Completed folders stand beside her, with a plant at the window. Diffuse afternoon light catches her black hair and earrings, casting tidy paper-edge shadows across the desk.
